title: Actor Ko Kyung-pyo admits to drunk driving after collision, says he exposed himself at Han River to dispel disgrace
text:
Actor Ko Kyung-pyo admits to drunk driving after collision, says he exposed himself at Han River to dispel disgrace - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 11월 14일(토) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Entertainment Actor Ko Kyung-pyo admits to drunk driving after collision, says he exposed himself at Han River to dispel disgrace 
 입력 2026.11.14. 13:40 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 Actor Ko Kyung-pyo caused deep disappointment with drunken driving, and attention is also focusing on the part where he said his saju is full of disgrace.
 Ko Kyung-pyo collided with a street sweeper while driving his car in the Donggyo-dong area of Mapo District, Seoul, at about 3:30 a.m. on the 14th. At the time of the accident, his blood alcohol concentration was reported to be at the level that would cancel a driver's license.
 Ko Kyung-pyo's side said, "In the early hours of that day he collided with a street sweeper while driving under the influence, and the breathalyzer showed a blood alcohol concentration at the level for license cancellation. After finishing police questioning he returned home, and he admits his wrongdoing and is deeply reflecting. He will humbly accept whatever penalties are imposed going forward and will do his part to make restitution and take responsibility."
 At the same time, an anecdote about Ko Kyung-pyo saying he had a lot of disgrace and that he once exposed himself naked at a Han River outdoor pool as a way to dispel it is being reexamined.
 On Feb. 22 last year, on the YouTube channel 'DdeunDdeun' in a video titled "Travel friends are just an excuse," Ko Kyung-pyo said, "I love swimming so much that I buy a season pass to the Jamwon Han River swimming pool and go every year."
 Ko Kyung-pyo said, "The funny thing is there are people who come every year. I go like this, and sometimes I surprise people." When Mimi, surprised that he went to an outdoor pool off-season in that condition, asked, "Don't people usually take off their tops at pools now?" Ko Kyung-pyo laughed and said, "Absolutely. I'm not shy, am I?"
 Admiring his lack of shame and free spirit, Yu Jae-seok said, "Life should be like Ko Kyung-pyo." Ko Kyung-pyo said, "They told me my saju has a lot of flesh. They said if you show your body naked where many people are, it will be interpreted and it reduces disgrace. To cut down on disgrace, I show my body naked in front of many people, and because they told me to be close to water, the Han River outdoor pool is the ideal place."
 Although Ko Kyung-pyo said he showed himself naked every year at the Han River pool to dispel disgrace, the major setback of drunk driving could not be avoided. The disgrace spread widely, and he has as many as four variety shows he is appearing on or was scheduled to appear on. Next week's fan meeting was also canceled, putting a red light on his activities.
